claims.statement: An upgrade transaction cannot start until all other open connections to the same database are closed; if any remain open, a blocked event is fired.

proof.quote: An upgrade transaction cannot start until all other open connections to the same database are closed; if any remain open, a blocked event is fired.

claims.statement: The versionchange event is fired on open database connections when a new connection attempts to upgrade the database version.

proof.quote: The versionchange event is fired on open database connections when a new connection attempts to upgrade the database version.
